xs.$description: Smallest inline icon — within dense content such as table cells

sm.$description: Small inline icon — standard inline usage

md.$description: Default icon size. Matches the 24x24 source grid 1:1

lg.$description: Large icon — prominent placements and empty states

stroke.$description: 1px, at every size. DDR-023: Lucide ships 2px and Single Record overrides it globally. Do NOT vary stroke by size — this token previously carried a 2 'default' and a 1.75 'dense' pair that no icon has ever used. Every SVG in foundations/iconography/svg/ is stroke-width 1, and npm run check:icons fails on any that is not.

outline.$description: Default variant for all icons. Stroke only, no fill.

filled.$description: Reserved for navigation active states only. Filled variants are not assigned speculatively — each must be explicitly required by a navigation component. A mark that needs a second colour is a component, not an icon (DDR-027).
